what: While the stage of the section (200vh) is pinned to the screen, two giant title halves spread 30vw left and right gather toward the center with scroll (.95 · cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)). Letters settle in place from 80px outward and .95 vertical, starting from the inner letters at .022s intervals (expo.out, scrub .5). The photo window between the halves opens from inset 50%, and the photo inside changes every .8 seconds while the section is visible

options.shift: Distance characters come in from outside (px), default 80
options.[data-fx-part=stage]: Stage pinned to the screen (the section itself if none)
options.[data-fx-part=window] · [data-fx-part=ph: (If present) center photo window and the photos that change inside it

use:
The gap

Fills in
note: When splitting text, words are kept as inline-block chunks so Korean lines don’t break mid-word (the title is written on one line). The photo window sits behind the title (z 0)
